parts.1:
Questions 1–5

1 What do they still need to buy in the shop?

Girl: OK, Dad, have we got everything we need?

Man: Yes, I think so. We’ve got mushrooms and quite a lot of other vegetables. And we don’t need any carrots.

Girl: Oh, I’ve just remembered! Mum asked us to get some fish, didn’t she?

Man: Oh yes, that’s right. I’ll go and get some.

Girl: Good idea. I’ll wait here.

2 What has just happened?

Boy: Ooh! Did you see that? The guy had the ball, but then suddenly he fell!

Man: Yeah, it was strange, because there was no one near him. He was trying to get a goal.

Boy: Look at him, he’s still lying on the grass. I think he’s really hurt himself.

Man: Yeah, he needs help.

3 Which is the woman’s suitcase?

Woman: Hey, I just got off the flight from Chicago. My luggage is lost. It’s my suitcase.

Man: Right. We’ll try and help. I’ll show you some pictures of suitcases. Has it got wheels?

Woman: Yes, it has. It also has black and white stripes.

Man: Anything else on it? Any pictures or faces on the suitcase, like some people have?

Woman: No, nothing like that.

4 What is the girl going to have?

Man: Hello, how can I help?

Girl: Can I have a tea… and, have you got any cakes? Like lemon cake, that was really nice last time.

Man: I’ve just sold the last one, I’m afraid. But I’ve got ice creams, they’re good. Would you like one?

Girl: No, thank you. It’s OK. I’ll just have the tea. I’ve already had one ice cream today!

Man: OK, no problem! Just a drink, then.

5 What have they just watched?

Boy: That was brilliant! I loved the violins!

Girl: Yeah, I loved it too, but I was watching the dancers all the time. How can they stand on their toes like that?

Boy: They wear special shoes, I think. I came to an opera here once, but I didn’t like it.

Girl: Right. I’m glad there was no singing today. The dancers moved so beautifully!

Boy: Yes, they did.
parts.2:
Questions 6–10

Woman: Hello everyone, on our tours of Bristol, your guide will show you the city’s amazing street art. Street art means pictures that are painted outside, on the street. And in fact, probably the finest examples in the city are by a motorway! They’ll show you art in other places as well, from a bridge to a roundabout. You’ll see brilliant paintings of different subjects – animals, water, and one of a baby, which is the largest example of street art in the city. You’ll also see the work of a fantastic street artist who has lived all his life in Bristol. He’s called Inkie, that’s I-N-K-I-E, so you can look online and see some of the things he’s done. Our next tour, on April the twenty-fourth is already full, but there are spaces on April the twenty-fifth. But remember that places do get booked very quickly. I’m sure you’ll love it – customers always say how much they like the guides and the stories they tell.
parts.3:
Questions 11–15

Ben: You know there’s a new skate park in town?

Gabby: Yeah. Did your sister tell you, Ben?

Ben: She never tells me anything, Gabby! It was my brother. His girlfriend’s been there.

Gabby: I found out some time ago.

Ben: Oh!

Gabby: Skate parks are usually just in big places, so it’s brilliant that our little town has one, too. And it’s close to our flat! Now it’s open I can’t wait to try it!

Ben: Me too. Some friends invited me today actually. But I’m busy after school. I’m free tomorrow, but they’re not.

Gabby: Why don’t you go at the weekend?

Ben: That’s our plan.

Gabby: Do you think it’ll be popular?

Ben: Probably. Everyone I know has already learnt to skate.

Gabby: Yeah. Most of my friends have skateboards, or borrow a friend’s.

Ben: I think they should film themselves at the park and share that.

Gabby: Good idea. More people will want to go when they see that.

Ben: I hope they’ll offer more activities at the park.

Gabby: Well, there’s already tennis.

Ben: Yeah. I mean, I know there’s not room for golf or anything like that. But I think they should build a climbing wall. Wouldn’t that be cool?

Gabby: Yeah, I’d like that!
parts.4:
Questions 16–20

16 You will hear two friends talking about a film.

Girl: I wanted to see that film, because the main bad guy – he’s my favourite actor.

Boy: Oh he was such a horrible character! It wasn’t a great film though. Half the time, I was thinking ‘What’s actually happening?’

Girl: Yeah, it wasn’t always clear. And the music was strange!

Boy: Yes, it was. When something bad happened, we had happy music! I didn’t mind that though.

17 You will hear the beginning of a talk for school pupils about nature.

Woman: Hello everyone. We’re used to hearing why it’s important for us to protect nature. But my subject today is ways that nature can be good for us, ways it helps us relax. Being in beautiful places like forests – you don’t need to learn the names of all the trees – just being there can make people stop worrying about things.

18 You will hear two classmates talking about the guide on a school trip to the countryside.

Boy: The guide was great wasn’t she?

Girl: Yeah, sometimes the guides on school trips think they’re funny, even when they’re not!

Boy: Yeah! She was asked some hard questions by those girls who were really interested in wildlife.

Girl: I know! I was thinking ‘Is there anything she can’t answer?’

Boy: She definitely knows her stuff! And she obviously finds plants interesting.

19 You will hear a man talking to his daughter about playing tennis after school.

Father: I hear there’s an after-school tennis club starting. Do you like the sound of that?

Daughter: That might be fun. I think I’m free any day, so it doesn’t particularly matter when exactly.

Father: You could have a game with your classmates and call me whenever you finish, I’d pick you up.

Daughter: I want to check if any of them are joining first. If they are, I will.

20 You will hear two friends planning a trip to the beach.

Boy: I was thinking that the bit of the beach where we had a picnic last time … nearest the train station, isn’t great for our volleyball game. It’s too crowded.

Girl: Why don’t we go to the area by the large car park?

Boy: You mean where they do the surfing training?

Girl: In that direction, yes, but further away. There’s more space over there.
parts.5:
Questions 21–25

Daughter: Hi Dad. The school activities day was brilliant!

Dad: Good. What did your friends do?

Daughter: Ellie wasn’t sure what to choose but then did baseball, and loved it.

Dad: Oh! What about Katherine?

Daughter: She wanted to do golf, but didn’t get a place. She chose hockey instead. She also thought about going cycling, but then decided not to.

Dad: I see. I guess Ruben did surfboarding did he?

Daughter: That was for beginners, and he’s done surfboarding a lot, so he’s too good. But he’s never tried golf, so that’s what he did. He wanted something with no swimming!

Dad: Oh right!

Daughter: And Elsa went for the bike ride. It wasn’t what she most wanted. That was sailing, but it was too expensive.

Dad: What did Celia choose? Riding horses?

Daughter: She didn’t know if she wanted to do that or tennis. But then when she saw a picture of the animals, she knew she just had to ride one!

Dad: I see!

Daughter: Guess what Andy did!

Dad: Maybe hockey?

Daughter: He was told no places were available. So he went to the pool instead.

Dad: Great!

Daughter: But he wants to do surfboarding next time.

explanations.p1q1: 爸爸问东西是否都买齐了，女孩说"We’ve got mushrooms and quite a lot of other vegetables. And we don’t need any carrots."，说明蔬菜已经买好、胡萝卜也不缺；接着她想起"Mum asked us to get some fish, didn’t she?"，爸爸答应马上去拿，可见还缺的只有鱼，因此选择 C。
explanations.p1q2: 男孩说那名球员"The guy had the ball, but then suddenly he fell!"，男士补充当时"there was no one near him"，男孩又说"he’s still lying on the grass. I think he’s really hurt himself."，可见刚发生的是有球员受伤倒地、需要帮助，因此选择 C。
explanations.p1q3: 女士的行李箱有轮子，"It also has black and white stripes."；男士问她上面有没有人物或人脸图案，她回答"No, nothing like that."，因此选的是带黑白条纹、没有图案的那只箱子，即 A。
explanations.p1q4: 女孩想点茶再加一块柠檬蛋糕，但男士说"I’ve just sold the last one, I’m afraid."；他推荐冰淇淋也被拒绝，女孩说"I’ll just have the tea. I’ve already had one ice cream today!"，最后只要了一杯茶，因此选择 A。
explanations.p1q5: 男孩说很喜欢小提琴，女孩说"I was watching the dancers all the time."，还问舞者怎么能立起脚尖，并庆幸"I’m glad there was no singing today."，舞者的动作很优美，可见他们刚看的是芭蕾舞演出；男孩提到曾在这里看过歌剧但不喜欢，说明这次不是歌剧，因此选择 B。
explanations.p2q1: 正确答案是 motorway。女士介绍布里斯托尔街头艺术时说"probably the finest examples in the city are by a motorway!"，即全城最好的街头艺术作品在一条高速公路旁边；她提到的桥和环岛只是行程中会看到的其他地点，不是“最好作品”所在处。
explanations.p2q2: 正确答案是 baby。女士列举画作题材时说"animals, water, and one of a baby, which is the largest example of street art in the city."，其中画婴儿的那幅是全城最大的街头艺术作品；动物和水是另外两幅画的题材，不要误填。
explanations.p2q3: 正确答案是 Inkie。女士说大家还能看到一位毕生住在布里斯托尔的街头艺术家的作品，"He’s called Inkie, that’s I-N-K-I-E"，她逐个字母拼读名字，据此填写 Inkie。
explanations.p2q4: 正确答案是 25 April。女士说下一班游览团"Our next tour, on April the twenty-fourth is already full"，即 4 月 24 日已满员，但"there are spaces on April the twenty-fifth"，还有名额的是 4 月 25 日，故填 25 April。
explanations.p2q5: 正确答案是 stories。结尾女士说"customers always say how much they like the guides and the stories they tell."，游客们一直称赞导游以及他们讲的故事，故填 stories（导游的 stories）。
explanations.p3q1: Gabby 猜是 Ben 的姐姐告诉他的，她问"Did your sister tell you, Ben?"，Ben 回答"She never tells me anything, Gabby! It was my brother."，可见其实是哥哥告诉他的，因此选择 A。
explanations.p3q2: Gabby 说滑板公园"And it’s close to our flat! Now it’s open I can’t wait to try it!"，即公园就在她家附近，一开放她就迫不及待想去试试，她因离家近而兴奋，因此选择 A；她并没有觉得公园太大，也没有对公园已开放感到惊讶。
explanations.p3q3: 有朋友今天约他，但 Ben 说"I’m busy after school. I’m free tomorrow, but they’re not."；Gabby 建议"Why don’t you go at the weekend?"，Ben 答"That’s our plan."，可见他周末才去，因此选择 C。
explanations.p3q4: Ben 建议大家"I think they should film themselves at the park and share that."，Gabby 认同并说"More people will want to go when they see that."，即在公园拍滑板视频分享出去会让公园更受欢迎，因此选择 B。
explanations.p3q5: Gabby 指出"Well, there’s already tennis."，Ben 也说"I know there’s not room for golf or anything like that. But I think they should build a climbing wall."，Gabby 表示她也想要，可见两人希望新增攀岩，因此选择 B。
explanations.p4q1: 男孩说"Half the time, I was thinking ‘What’s actually happening?’"，女孩也承认"Yeah, it wasn’t always clear."，可见这部电影的问题是故事难看懂；配乐虽然奇怪但男孩说"I didn’t mind that though"，因此选择 C。
explanations.p4q2: 她说"We’re used to hearing why it’s important for us to protect nature. But my subject today is ways that nature can be good for us, ways it helps us relax."，还说身处树林"just being there can make people stop worrying about things."，可见她要讲的是自然如何让我们放松、对我们有益，因此选择 B。
explanations.p4q3: 女孩说她在想"I was thinking ‘Is there anything she can’t answer?’"，男孩说"She definitely knows her stuff! And she obviously finds plants interesting."，可见他们夸这位导游知识渊博，因此选择 A；“觉得有趣”是女孩对一些学校旅行导游的批评，难题也是学生问导游的，并非导游提问。
explanations.p4q4: 女儿说"I think I’m free any day, so it doesn’t particularly matter when exactly."，可见她不关心具体哪天；她要先弄清"I want to check if any of them are joining first. If they are, I will."，即有没有别的同学也参加，因此选择 A。
explanations.p4q5: 男孩说上次野餐、近火车站的那片沙滩"isn’t great for our volleyball game. It’s too crowded."，女孩建议去大停车场那边更远些，因为"There’s more space over there."，可见两人在商量去海滩哪一段，因此选择 A。
explanations.p5q1: 她本想打高尔夫但没有名额，"She wanted to do golf, but didn’t get a place. She chose hockey instead."；骑自行车她想过但最终放弃，所以 Katherine 选的是曲棍球 D。
explanations.p5q2: 滑板冲浪是初学者项目，"That was for beginners, and he’s done surfboarding a lot, so he’s too good."，而"But he’s never tried golf, so that’s what he did."，所以 Ruben 选了高尔夫 C。
explanations.p5q3: "And Elsa went for the bike ride."，但那不是她最想选的，"That was sailing, but it was too expensive."，所以 Elsa 最后去骑了自行车 B。
explanations.p5q4: 她原本在骑马和网球之间犹豫，但"when she saw a picture of the animals, she knew she just had to ride one!"，可见 Celia 最后选了骑马 E。
explanations.p5q5: 他想选的曲棍球没有名额，"He was told no places were available. So he went to the pool instead."，即 Andy 去游泳 H；女孩还说他下次想试滑板冲浪。

uncertain: p1q2: 文本层原作 “They guy had the ball”，按上下文与音频判读转写为 “The guy had the ball”
